statement.zh: **算法**：KMAC 基于散列的 MAC（KMAC）。构造在 §4.3 印出：「KMAC concatenates a padded version of the key K with the input X and an encoding of the requested output length L.The result is then passed to cSHAKE, along with the requested output length L, the name N」，即密钥先按字节对齐填充，再把输入与输出长度编码一并喂给 cSHAKE，函数名 KMAC 用作域分隔。§1 把它归入四类派生函数之一：「All four functions defined in this Recommendation--cSHAKE, KMAC, TupleHash, and ParallelHash--have these properties in common:」。
statement.en: **Algorithm**: KMAC (KMAC 基于散列的 MAC).The construction is printed in §4.3: "KMAC concatenates a padded version of the key K with the input X and an encoding of the requested output length L.

statement.zh: 存在理由有两句支撑。§1 把 KMAC 定性为带密钥、可变长输出的伪随机函数族成员（该节列出的就是这几类功能）。§8.2.2 用对照表说明与既有 MAC 的等价关系：「To illustrate the security properties of KMAC for given parameter settings, Table 1 lists a few other approved MAC algorithms along with equivalent settings」，即 KMAC 的动机是在 SHA-3 体系内提供与 HMAC/CMAC 可对齐的参数化选择，而不是另造一套强度口径。
statement.en: Two sentences carry the rationale.§1 characterises KMAC as a member of the keyed, variable-output pseudorandom-function family the document defines.

statement.zh: §4 印出两条用法。定长用法就是函数本体「KMAC128(K, X, L, S)」，其第二步直接返回 cSHAKE128 的结果；变长用法由文本单独说明：「Some applications of KMAC may not know the number of output bits they will need until after the outputs begin to be produced.For these applications, KMAC can also be used as a XOF (i.e., the output can be extended to any desired length)」，即 KMACXOF 用于事先不知道要多少比特的场合。
statement.en: Section 4 prints both uses.The fixed-length use is the function itself, KMAC128(K, X, L, S), whose second step returns the cSHAKE128 result directly.

statement.zh: 限度由同一节的规范性句子给出，且是强约束：「Approved uses of KMAC require the length of K to be at least the required security strength, as discussed in Sec.8.4.1.」即密钥长度不足直接使`经批准`的用法不成立。同一节还印有有效性条件「Validity Conditions: len(K) < 22040 and 0  L < 22040 and len(S) < 22040」（该行在本副本里把上标拉平成连排数字），超出即不在函数定义域内。
statement.en: The limit is a normative sentence with teeth: "Approved uses of KMAC require the length of K to be at least the required security strength, as discussed in Sec.8.4.1." An undersized key defeats approved use outright.

statement.zh:
版本事实来自留存文本自身：题头行为「SHA-3 DERIVED FUNCTIONS: CSHAKE, KMAC, TUPLEHASH, AND PARALLELHASH」，即 SP 800-185（2022 年 12 月）首次把这四个派生函数一并标准化。§2.1 在定义 KECCAK 家族时交代了上一环：「KECCAK was originally specified in [2], and standardized in FIPS 202.」名称来历由同节脚注写明 KMAC 即 KECCAK Message Authentication Code 的缩写。本留存件每页还印有一行免费获取提示并给出数字对象标识符，该行按本项目口径不在正文里逐字引用。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(T=\mathrm{MAC}_K(M),\quad \Pr[\mathrm{Forge}]\le\varepsilon(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：KMAC 基于散列的 MAC的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：K 共享密钥，M 消息，T 认证标签。
statement.en: The version facts come from the retained text itself: the title line reads "SHA-3 DERIVED FUNCTIONS: CSHAKE, KMAC, TUPLEHASH, AND PARALLELHASH", so SP 800-185 (December 2022) is where these four derived functions were standardised together.§2.1 supplies the earlier link while defining the KECCAK family: "KECCAK was originally specified in [2], and standardized in FIPS 202." The same section records that KMAC stands for KECCAK Message Authentication Code.
